data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
China’s first lunar lander (December 2013), carrying the Yutu rover. Mare Imbrium touchdown — the first soft landing on the Moon since Luna 24 in 1976.
First Chinese soft landing on the Moon; deployed Yutu, China's first lunar rover
China's GTO workhorse — Chang'e lunar landers + most Chinese comsats
First soft landing on lunar far side
First-ever lunar far-side sample return. Apollo basin landing 2024-06-01 (UTC); 1935 g returned to Inner Mongolia 2024-06-25
ExoMars precursor; lessons fed Rosalind Franklin
Confirmed water ice in Martian soil

China's first lunar landing — the first soft landing anywhere on the Moon in 37 years. The Chang'e 3 lander is still alive, making it the longest-surviving lunar lander ever. Yutu drove 114 m before its drive mechanism failed, but its instruments continued returning science data.
